facts.topic: SEBI minimum contract value - INDEX derivatives
facts.value: Raised from Rs 5-10 lakh band to: not less than Rs 15 lakh at introduction, lot size reviewed so contract value stays within Rs 15-20 lakh. Applies to index futures/options only, effective 2024-11-20.

facts.topic: SEBI minimum contract value - STOCK derivatives, unchanged
facts.value: Single-stock futures/options remain under the Oct-2015 framework: lot size fixed so contract value on day of review is within Rs 5 lakh - Rs 10 lakh. No 2025/2026 revision found.

facts.topic: Representative NIFTY 50 stock futures lot sizes and approx contract values (Aug 2026)
facts.value: RELIANCE lot 500 ~Rs 6.65 lakh; HDFCBANK lot 650 ~Rs 4.8 lakh; ICICIBANK lot 700 ~Rs 9.9 lakh; INFY lot 400 ~Rs 4.2 lakh; TCS lot 225 ~Rs 5.5 lakh; ITC lot 1725 ~Rs 4.65 lakh; SBIN lot 750 ~Rs 7.9 lakh; BHARTIARTL lot 475 ~Rs 9.5 lakh; LT lot 175 ~Rs 7.2 lakh; TMPV (ex-TATAMOTORS PV) lot 1600 ~Rs 5.1-5.6 lakh.
facts.source: Aggregated broker derivative pages (5paisa, Angel One, ICICI Direct, Groww, Dhan) Aug 2026; Tata Motors demerger: https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/tata-motors-demerger-impact-changes-in-futures-options-lot-size-open-interest-strikes-prices-explained-125110600114_1.html

facts.value: Regulatory floor: SPAN scan range min 10% of contract value; exposure margin = max(3.5%, 1.5 sd of 6-month log returns). Broker-quoted NRML totals for large caps typically 17-26% of contract value (range 14-35%); some Sept-2026 Zerodha snapshots for RELIANCE/HDFCBANK/ICICIBANK showed 33-41% (unverified JS-rendered fetch).
0.02% sell-side from 2024-10-01; Union Budget 2026 raised it to 0.05% sell-side effective 2026-04-01 (CURRENT). Options STT 0.15%. No STT on futures buy side.

facts.topic: Exchange txn charge, SEBI fee, stamp duty, GST, brokerage on futures
facts.value: NSE equity futures exchange transaction charge 0.00173% of turnover (one Zerodha page still shows 0.00183%); SEBI fee Rs 10/crore (0.0001%) both sides; stamp duty 0.002% buy side only; GST 18% on brokerage + SEBI + exchange charges (not on STT/stamp); Zerodha brokerage min(0.03%, Rs 20) per executed order.

NIFTY futures premium ~Rs 150 over spot ~24,335 on 2026-08-25 (~0.6%/month); monthly premiums Jan-2025 87 pts, May-2025 34 pts, Jan-2026 196 pts; market-wide monthly rollover cost ~45-65 bps observed. No per-stock dataset found; index proxy only.
All stock F&O compulsorily physically settled since Oct-2019 expiry (SEBI 2018-04-11 circular). ITM at expiry -> delivery/receipt of shares.

Additional physical-delivery margin on ITM positions: E-4 10%, E-3 25%, E-2 45%, E-1 70%, E 100% of (VaR+ELM+adhoc) x qty x price. SEBI Feb-2026 circular withdrew calendar-spread margin benefit on expiry day for single-stock derivatives.
s.43(5) proviso (d): eligible exchange-traded derivative transactions are not speculative -> non-speculative business income; losses set off against other heads except salary, carry-forward 8 years.

Zerodha SLB: Series B (non-F&O) only; borrow min 500 shares; lend min Rs 1 lakh per security; monthly contracts; lending fee 0.5-10% annualised market-determined; Zerodha takes 20% of lending fee + GST; full-value collateral for borrowing. For NIFTY 50 names futures are the cheaper short route; SLB is a fallback.

worked_example_round_trip_bps.assumptions: One stock-futures lot, contract value Rs 15,00,000 both legs, Zerodha, rates as of Aug 2026 (post 2026-04-01 STT hike). Excludes slippage, margin financing, roll.

caveats: Live prices/margins change daily; lot sizes revised periodically.
Exchange txn charge 0.00173% vs 0.00183% ambiguity is immaterial (<Rs 2/lot).
No per-stock basis/roll dataset; index proxy is the weakest item.
TATAMOTORS split into TMPV/TMCV on 2025-10-01; F&O relaunched 2025-10-14.
Feb-2026 calendar-spread circular number not independently confirmed.
Margin snapshots 33-41% may be an artifact of a non-JS fetch; verify live.
